title: pelargonium fulgidum
intro: Pelargonium fulgidum, commonly known as Red Form or Red Geranium, is a species of succulent plant in the family Geraniaceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium fulgidum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin irritations.
